up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293237 (RecQ-like DNA helicase BLM). Output columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays.chembl_id), target type (from target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (from target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (which must be 'IC50'), and pChEMBL value (from activities.pchembl_value). Only include rows where standard_relation is '=' and pchembl_value is not null. Filter for target CHEMBL1293237, organism Homo sapiens, and target_type 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       act.standard_type,
       act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293237'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
